events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: The HOLD MY WHEEL demo has landed. Team up with your idiot twin brothers, patch up the bus, and scavenge your way through the wasteland toward grandma's house. Fight zombies, dodge disaster, and try not to lose the bus - it's the only home you've got. Play it now and let us know what you think!

events.title: FIRST BUGS FIXED
events.summary: Huge thanks for your videos, we really appreciate this contribution. We'll gladly give you a spot inside the game, just send us your nickname. Big respect to everyone who found those first critical bugs, I'm really glad you helped us out!

events.title: PLAYTEST IS NOW OPEN
events.summary: The playtest is open! 🎮 Hold My Wheel is now playable — grab the wheel and jump in. What's in it: New features — fresh content we haven't shown anywhere yet Find bugs — break the game and help us fix it Share feedback — what you say shapes the release build How to join: Hit "Request Access" on the Steam page — access is granted automatically. ➜ Join the playtest: Thanks for helping out! Drop anything you spot in the discussions — we read every message.
